Exercise: Straight Raises on Incline Bench

Category:
strength

Exercise Type:
isolation

Force Type:
push

Difficulty Level:
beginner

Movement Patterns:

- shoulder_extension

Primary Muscles:

- shoulders

Secondary Muscles:

- traps

Equipment:

- barbell

Fatigue Score:
3

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
2

Energy Requirement:
moderate

Recovery Time:
1.5 hours

Goals:

- shoulder_strength
- trapezius_development

Contraindications:
None

Exercise Variations:

- name: Barbell Upright Row, equipment: barbell
- name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise, equipment: dumbbells

Substitution Options:

- exercise_name: Lateral Raises on Cable Machine, equipment: cable machine

Instructions:

- Place a bar on the ground behind the head of an incline bench.
- Lay on the bench face down. With a pronated grip, pick the barbell up from the floor, keeping your arms straight. Allow the bar to hang straight down. This will be your starting position.
- To begin, raise the barbell out in front of your head while keeping your arms extended.
- Return to the starting position.
